newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Stock Exchange names new president.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Stock Exchange names new president.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange on Wednesday named banking executive Vitaliano Nanagas as its new president, replacing Eduardo de los Angeles.
PSE chairman Wilson Sy said in a statement that Nanagas, a former Citibank executive and president of the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corp, "is a man whose integrity is beyond reproach".
Nanagas, currently Global Business Bank president and a member of the Capital Market Development Council, will take up his new job on October 7, Sy said.
De los Angeles is stepping down after the end of a three-year contract as the first president of the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The bourse was set up in 1993 when two separate, and often feuding, exchanges were unified.
